header: Loading streaming data from Amazon CloudWatch
content:
You can load streaming data from CloudWatch Logs to your OpenSearch Service domain by using
a CloudWatch Logs subscription. For information about Amazon CloudWatch subscriptions, see
Real-time processing of log data with subscriptions. For conﬁguration information, see Streaming
CloudWatch Logs data to Amazon OpenSearch Service in the Amazon CloudWatch Developer Guide.
